name: fac-role-play-practice-kit
description: Builds the practice for a conversation people must learn, producing four to six learning points, a good and a poor model of the same conversation, role cards for trios, rounds that move to cases participants bring, and observer notes that go only to the learner. Use for "run fac-role-play-practice-kit", "role play scenarios for training", "role play without the cringe", "difficult conversation practice", "feedback conversation practice", "behaviour modelling", "observer notes", "people hate role play", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
